incremental_content: The exact candidate replaces earlier k^4/k^2 home caps with nu<=1/(1024k) for k>=2 and removes any k=1 cap.
The author route uses reciprocal-gradient profile potential, fixed-profile LP feasibility, matching-based profile oracle, rational Frank-Wolfe and one-sided logarithm truncation.

The independent/NSW route keeps an actual independent incidence set, proves same-outer weighted L-infinity/L1 bounds, uses a piecewise reciprocal potential with relative curvature, and outputs all original jobs through one shared matching.
Both routes remain narrow typed single-state domains and are not general unrelated-machines results.
comparison.non_merge_reason: Earlier reviews cover k^4/k^2 candidate domains, different constants, finite backend checks and older proof routes. This four-source batch is a later O(1/k) working candidate; preserve its exact/proof/independent/informed roles and do not silently upgrade it to an end-to-end theorem or software result.
